commons.description:
In 1958 priest-shaman Luang Pu Bunleua Sulilat, who integrated Hinduism and Buddhism, built this park full of concrete sculptures.

One sculpture resembles a giant pumpkin. It has three stories representing three levels - Hell, Earth and Heaven. Visitors can enter through an opening (which is a mouth of a 10 ft tall demon head) and climb staircases from hell to heaven.
